model.rateOfFire: ProjectileWeaponComponent +4 rounds_per_minute: three f32 slots X/Y/Z. Y (+8) is the default and the only rate of a weapon without a ROF selector. With WeaponFunctionType ROF bound to an input, each press moves to the next slot (Y -> Z -> X), skipping 0.0 slots. Fixed storage: three rates at most.
model.inputs: WeaponDataComponent function_info {left +184, right +188}: the WeaponFunctionType on each weapon-function input; 0 = none. Read from the built weapon.
model.programmableAmmo: With ProgrammableAmmo bound and switched on, every shot fires ProjectileWeapon +576 instead of the normal projectile (when +576 is non-zero).
model.roundsFeeds: WeaponRounds +64 / +68: the primary and alternate magazine projectiles, +72 their capacities; the Magazine function switches between them.
model.ownership: Every member is weapon data on the weapon entity record, copied into or read through the built weapon (projectile_weapon ROF record, weapon_data bindings); a weapon built after a write uses it.
